europe_now.title: NATO and Regional Airspace Incidents
europe_now.summary: NATO jets intercepted and shot down a drone over Lithuania while a Russian naval vessel fired flares at a Danish helicopter. These events underscore rising regional tensions and security challenges across European airspace.

sources.headline: NATO jets down drone over Lithuania as Russian ship fires flares at Danish helicopter

europe_now.title: EU Leadership State of the Union Address
europe_now.summary: European Commission President Ursula von der Leyen delivered her State of the Union address, addressing global threats including relations with the United States and Russia. She also proposed the creation of a new European Security Council and initiatives regarding artificial intelligence.

sources.headline: Von der Leyen tries to stem tide on global threats ― from Trump to AI and climate
Live: EU chief Ursula von der Leyen gives State of the Union address

top_stories.title: US Charges Alleged Russian Intelligence Network
top_stories.summary: United States authorities have exposed an alleged Russian terror and intelligence network targeting Ukraine allies. The network faces various charges related to planned operations against regional partners.

sources.headline: US exposes alleged Russian terror network targeting Ukraine allies

top_stories.title: Crackdown on Activism in Turkey
top_stories.summary: Turkish authorities have arrested dozens of individuals during a broad crackdown targeting LGBTQ+ activists. The sweeping arrests have drawn international scrutiny regarding human rights and civil liberties.

sources.headline: Turkey arrests dozens in crackdown on LGBTQ+ activists
